events.title: Yoga in the Park
events.description:
@

Join Sol Spirit Yoga & Wellness for Yoga in the Park, an open-level and donation-based class suitable for all! All donations will benefit our local community farmers market and the park. Each week, an experienced Sol Spirit instructor will guide you through a thoughtful and energizing practice.

Walk-ins are welcome, but please register in advance whenever using the link below.

Sol Spirit Yoga & Wellness is a community-focused studio in Jersey City Heights, proudly serving the neighborhood since 2021. Opening shortly after the closure of Sattva Yoga, Sol Spirit has continued to hold space and be of service to the local community. This boutique-style studio offers a warm and inclusive environment for students of all levels, with smaller class sizes that allow for personalized attention and support. Classes are led by experienced local teachers who are not only instructors, but neighbors and friends, deeply connected to the community they serve. Sol Spirit has been voted Best Yoga Studio in Jersey City three years in a row (2023, 2024, 2025). As a Latina and woman-owned business, Sol Spirit is committed to accessibility, diversity, and meaningful community impact.

Suggested donation $10

events.title: QiGong with Erin Kumpf
events.description:
@

Erin Kumpf from Erin Kumpf Acupuncture & Herbs brings QiGong to the Riverview Farmers Market on the first Sunday of every month from May through October. This free class requires no experience and no equipment.

What is QiGong?
Often described as a sister practice to Tai Chi, QiGong is a gentle, meditative movement practice rooted in the cultivation of energy. While Tai Chi follows structured forms, QiGong is more fluid and intuitive—inviting you to slow down, soften, and reconnect with your breath and body. Through simple, flowing movements, we’ll create space for the nervous system to settle and the mind to quiet—an opportunity to reset in the midst of your day. All are welcome. Come as you are.

Erin Kumpf Acupuncture & Herbs
